runtimePackagePins.source: Measured source project/package pins; actual Tray binary identified by the independent assembly hash.

timestampSemantics: Producer timestamp preserved verbatim, including any offset; no UTC conversion or UTC label is inferred.

presentationChecks.presentation: offscreen AppWindow.Show(false); explicit x:Bind initialization; no activation

limits: Native/GDI before readings follow warmup and precede idle; their interval includes idle plus activity. Activity-start process counters are a later checkpoint.
GUI/native query errors and unavailable values are retained, not converted to zero. Native indices are resolved using this child report metadata.
Resource trends are preserved without timing/memory/handle thresholds; semantic validation is not proof of flat resource use.
Startup is an upper bound to loaded layout, not first paint; OS caches and ordinary host load were uncontrolled.
Disconnected synthetic/offscreen execution does not validate visible operation, installed Service/Session Agent power, GPU residency or multi-hour stability.
